    Igor Fabio Steinmacher

    Open-source sustainability, the human aspects of software engineering, and how AI is reshaping software ecosystems.

    The short version: he studies why people join open source, why they stay, and why they leave — and now how AI changes that.
    Who · 02

    Research area · 03

    Four threads, one question: how do software communities sustain themselves?

    01

    Onboarding & retention

    Why newcomers struggle, what mentoring helps, what makes contributors leave.

    02

    Sustainability & governance

    Community health, roles in practice, forecasting core-developer inactivity.

    03

    AI × software development

    Agents that support contributors rather than replace them; GenAI in practice.

    04

    Learning through open source

    Gamified scaffolding, OSS-Doorway, university↔community bridges.

    Threads 01–02 · 04

    The barrier to entry is social, not technical.

    A decade of empirical study into the friction newcomers hit when they try to contribute to open source — and the tools and practices that reduce it.

    • Systematic reviews of newcomer onboarding and mentoring practices.
    • Gender-inclusive OSS — tooling that widens participation (NSF CHS).
    • Contributor retention — what community managers can actually act on.
    • Forecasting developer inactivity — early warning for stalling projects.
    The findings are social and organizational — culture and mentorship, more than missing technical skill.

    Talking points · 06

    Where the work could meet ours.

    • 01Conversational AI for learners. His novice-scaffolding agents × our LLM teaching tools.
    • 02CSCW meets HRI. Human aspects of collaboration × our physiological measures.
    • 03Broadening participation. His HSI work × our K-12 BCI outreach.
    • 04Onboarding as an object of study. Transfers to research-lab onboarding.
    • 05AI reshaping education. Shared empirical-methods ground.
    • 06Programmatic collaboration. He runs SICCS graduate programs.
    Where to start · 07

    Lead with the overlap, not the introduction.

    • 01Agentic AI for learners — highest overlap, and his newest funding line.
    • 02CSCW × HRI — the one place our instruments are genuinely additive.

    Close with a light ask: a shared one-page concept note, not a commitment.
